title: Action Controller
intro: Action Controller is where Rails request handling lives, and interviewers go deep on three areas: callbacks (before_action execution order, skip_before_action, around_action), strong parameters (why they exist, how params.require.permit prevents mass assignment), and the render vs redirect_to distinction. This page covers all three plus sessions and cookies, respond_to format blocks, rescue_from for error handling, and controller concerns. The strong parameters question is a security question in disguise — interviewers want to know you understand that permit protects against overwriting attributes that should never be user-settable, not just that you know the API syntax.
